ablation_confounding.question: does style residualisation change the delivered Top-3? (point-estimate sets)

external_6csv.alignment: 6.csv row labels matched to q2_chem_meta corrLabel (normalised); 44/44 matched; columns taken in TARGET_COLS order; corrIndex indexes 2.csv (231x231, not registered)

method_jaccard.definition: J = |A n B| / (2k - |A n B|), k = 3; mean over 50 dimensions and the 6 method pairs

modules.note: modules are connected components of the |W| graph built on the 231 train-fold features (tau = 0.5); derive on the delivered graph, not on the test rows

settings.candidates: 219 single-compound columns (COMPOUND_CANDIDATES); the 5 derived sums and 7 physical parameters are excluded
settings.delivery: Top-3 per (dimension, method) ordered by bootstrap selection frequency pi, ties broken by the point-estimate score, then by the frozen candidate order
settings.direction: sign of the total Spearman correlation for the delivered (consensus) rows
settings.external: 6.csv is used only as external corroboration (rank correlation), never for fitting
settings.method: consensus of total Spearman / within-style Spearman / graph low-rank |B|
settings.scoring: ingredient scores are |Spearman|, |within-style partial Spearman on ranks| and |B_jt|; consensus = mean of the three within-dimension percentile ranks over the 219 candidates
settings.styleConfoundRule: style-driven if |rho_total| >= 0.25 and |rho_within| < 0.5|rho_total|; within-consistent if |rho_within| >= 0.8|rho_total|; otherwise mixed
settings.trainingRows: 200 rows of data/splits/SPLIT-0001/train.csv (registered dependency; the Q2 experiment hangs no split)
